notes.title: BUG FIX UPDATE - September 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/073e376de11eba379174845953f9429a32e1abee.png

Hello, fellow Estate Agents!

We’re excited to bring you the latest update, packed with bug fixes and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s a list of Bug Fixes addressed in this patch:

Item Spawn Issue: We’ve resolved the bug causing problems with item spawns. You should now experience smoother item placement and acquisition.

Dialogue Text Errors: The nonsensical characters and texts that appeared in dialogues have been corrected. Most conversations should now make perfect sense (but there will be some funny ones of course!)

Floating Items: Fixed the issue where some items were floating in the air inexplicably. Items should now behave as expected in their designated locations.

YukiHouse Purchase Error: We’ve addressed the error that prevented players from purchasing items at YukiHouse. The process should run smoothly now!

Farm Items in Vehicles: The bug affecting the placement and retrieval of farm items from vehicles has been resolved. Manage your farm inventory with ease!

House Item Count:  The issue with the number of items displayed inside houses has been fixed. The number should now accurately reflect the amount of furniture.

Collider Bug in Stackable Furniture:  We’ve tackled the collider bug that affected stackable house furniture. Arrange your furniture without collision issues!

Vehicle Disappearance: The problem of vehicles sometimes disappearing has been addressed. Important Note: If you’re still encountering this issue, please send us your ‘save files’ via Discord so we can investigate further.

Hotel PC UI Bug: The UI bug affecting the hotel PC has been resolved. Enjoy a seamless interface for all your hotel management needs.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. As always, we’re committed to improving your gaming experience, and we appreciate your patience as we work on these updates.

Happy gaming!

— KikiGames

notes.title: Camp Area Update! Out NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Estate Agents!

The day has come! Today we are introducing the Camping Area, a new feature that offers an extra possibility for increasing profit and building wealth!

What's New:

Camp Area: You can now buy a dedicated camp area. Once acquired, you'll have the freedom to build a variety of tents within your camp.
Earn income with tent rentals: Turn your camp into a bustling business by renting out your tents. The more tents you build, the more income you can generate.
Manage a new source of income: Keep track of your rentals and ensure to collect the payments from renters.

How It Works:
[olist]
Purchase Your Camp Area: Head to the camp area and acquire the land.
Build Tents: Use your resources to construct tents for future renters.
Rent Out Tents: Set your rental prices and start earning income from your campers.
Grow Your Business: Use your earnings to expand your camp, build more tents, and enhance your business.
[/olist]
We can't wait to see the creative and profitable camps you will build. Dive in now and start your camping adventure today! Be sure to show your camps on our Discord Server!
Happy Camping!
The Kiki Games Team

notes.content:

The Utopia Police Department has received several reports of houses being assaulted by masked suspects. The victims claim that several pieces of furniture have been subtracted from their properties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/4adc92d039121c931302de8a2812e3767f0ec238.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/917fdafdb9cabdde9e407f3bc4fcffb0a2e6a915.gif

We hope that this warning puts everyone under advice to minimize the amount of people affected. We will continue to update you through our channels at Discord! 

Thank you everyone, and take care! 


*Message from the Developer team:

Aside from the ‘Thieves System’, this update also brings a lot of bug fixes. We wanted to thank you all for helping us detect and correct these. If you experience any bugs or may have some questions, feel free to hop on our Discord server. We have dedicated channels to assist you in the best way possible! 

Thank you, and enjoy!

notes.title: TRAFFIC REGULATIONS UPDATE
notes.content:
Good day, people of Utopia, our beloved City! Chief of the Police Department here. 

I would love to take a bit of your time for a very important announcement.

Lately, we have been receiving a lot of reports from worried neighbours regarding the multiple traffic incidents that have been taking place in our beloved city by people who are performing reckless driving. This has led to a state of insecurity that our department can not tolerate. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/b55a19f90018709e8b41eb3b7ca43e2ada2cdca8.gif

Starting today, we will pursue this unacceptable behaviour with all our resources, to ensure that everyone who drives through our streets takes extreme caution and does not risk anyone’s security. 

From now on, every traffic incident will result in a fine of enough amount to make those uncivil drivers think twice before committing another fault.

For those involved in any upcoming traffic incident: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/52ca649643e01c695d8ec15d66c3c901ddee2685.gif

Every time you hit another person’s car, this incident will be reported and the fine will be deducted directly from your account in a lapse of 3 days. WARNING! Every single crash will be reported and charged simultaneously at the end of those 3 days.

Infractors will be notified by email when the charges are made to their accounts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/789e04ddf3fe1d32837319e53e63f48f87bf6dff.gif

We hope that this new traffic regulation delivers much safer streets for our beloved Utopia. 

We will continue receiving your reports in our citizen’s office at Discord

Thank you everyone, and take care!

notes.title: LANDSCAPE UPDATE is HERE!
notes.content:
Greetings, Estate Agents!

We're excited to share our newest update for Estate Agent Simulator! With this update, we're diving deep into the art of landscape architecture, giving you the power to transform ordinary houses into stunning and luxurious cribs that fetch top dollar on the market. Get ready to unleash your creativity and elevate your properties to new heights!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/3d383a847f93e088c67b07bcade42befe16d456b.gif

Landscape Architecture:

Now, more than ever, the exterior of your properties will be just as important as the interior. With the introduction of landscape architecture, you'll have the ability to design breathtaking gardens that will make your houses irresistible to potential buyers or renters. Beautify your surroundings and watch as your properties become the talk of the town!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/fc4a14fc76eee01bb879464c04db51e993ab4672.gif

+50 New Garden Items:

Yukii House is expanding its catalogue with over 50 new items specifically tailored for gardens. From cozy lounging spots to elegant decorations, you'll find everything you need to create the ultimate outdoor oasis. Additions like a garden area, garden umbrella, Barbeque, BBQ Island, Egg Chair, Fire pit, Furniture Set, Hot Tub, Pergola, Planter and much more are waiting at the store. And most of them have different variants!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/2a5165b0a9eaa9c42d48d27d32fc0fbcd9b5b23b.gif

Variants for Ultimate Design Freedom:

We understand that every property and every player has unique tastes. That's why each garden item comes with a range of variants, allowing you to customize and tailor your outdoor spaces to perfection. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531987/82cc776197352689034af77b6fb173b282179f1b.gif

Design your dream landscape: 

We're committed to continuously improving the Estate Agent Simulator experience based on your feedback. You just have to update your game and get access to all these new features!

Get ready to unleash your inner landscape architect and take your properties to the next level! Stay tuned for the release of this exciting update, out NOW!

The Estate Agent Simulator Dev Team
